dishes.name: Mardin kaburga dolması
dishes.desc: Lamb ribs stuffed with spiced rice, minced meat and nuts, then slow-cooked for hours. A protected-origin dish and the centrepiece of Mardin celebration tables.

dishes.name: Mardin kibe
dishes.desc: Bulgur shell stuffed with spiced minced meat and onion, fried or boiled; the city also does a tripe-wrapped version. A core dish of Mardin's Syriac and Arab kitchens.

dishes.name: İkbebet
dishes.desc: Layers of boiled bulgur and ground meat mixed with pomegranate or sumac-style tang and herbs, served cool. A protected Mardin speciality.

dishes.name: Sembusek
dishes.desc: Crescent-shaped pastry filled with minced meat and onion, fried or baked. Part of Mardin's Syriac food tradition and a protected-origin product.

dishes.name: Mardin almond candy
dishes.desc: Small pale sweets made from ground almonds and sugar. Mardin is known for it and shops in the old town sell it by weight.
